Container.Name: dissertation-worker
Container.Requires: The **dissertation-web** container, the same MySQL 8 database it uses, and the same host path mounted at /data/files. Install dissertation-web first.
Container.Overview:
The background worker for the dissertation research platform. Install **dissertation-web** first; this container is the second half of it and is not useful alone.
It polls a job table in the same MySQL database the web container uses and does the work a web request cannot wait for: compiling a manuscript with Pandoc and Tectonic, writing database and file backups, generating image derivatives, geocoding places, and syncing a Zotero library. Without it the site still serves, but uploads never get thumbnails, backups never run and no manuscript ever compiles.
THREE SETTINGS MUST MATCH dissertation-web EXACTLY:
1. The database host, name, user and password. They talk through that database; if they disagree, this container simply never sees a job. 2. The host path mounted at /data/files. The web app stages an assembled manuscript there and the worker reads it back. Different paths means compilation produces nothing and reports no error you would notice. 3. The uid on those directories. This image runs as uid 1000 and does not support PUID/PGID - chown the shares to 1000:1000 as described on dissertation-web.
Migrations are deliberately left off here. The web container applies them on start, and RUN_MIGRATIONS is fixed to false below so the two can never race. Do not change it.
This container has no web interface and publishes no port. To see what it is doing, read its log - it names each job it claims and what it did with it.
The Zotero API key, if you use one, belongs here and nowhere else. The web service never holds it: it enqueues a sync job and reads the result back, so the credential stays in the container that actually talks to the API.

Config.Name: Files
Config.Description: MUST be the identical host path dissertation-web uses. This is how compiled work is handed between them.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Where the backup job writes dumps and file archives. Point this at a share the host itself backs up.

Config.Name: Run migrations
Config.Description: Leave false. The web container owns migrations; two roles applying them would race.

Config.Name: Geocoder contact address
Config.Description: Nominatim asks every client to identify itself with a real contact address. Geocoding jobs fail rather than send anonymous traffic.

Config.Name: Zotero library ID
Config.Description: Optional. The numeric id from zotero.org/settings/keys, not your username.

Config.Name: Zotero API key
Config.Description: Optional, read-only. Belongs here and not on the web container - nothing ever writes back to Zotero.
